problems.arch: Asnas-a yezmer kan ad yettwasbedd ɣef tussda tusligt ({required}) lameɛna tussda n uqeddac-ik d {current}.
problems.broken: Asnas-a yerrez akken i d-fkan yikayaden iwurmanen n YunoHost, yerna yezmer ad yesxesser anagraw-ik! Yessefk ur t-tessbeddayeḍ ara anagar ma teẓriḍ d acu i txeddmeḍ.
problems.ignore: Gziɣ d akken asebded-a yezmer ad yeṛṛeẓ anagraw-iw, maca bɣiɣ ad ɛerḍeɣ.
problems.inprogress: Asnas-a mazal-it d asekran (neɣ ur yetteddu ara s wudem n tidet) yerna yezmer ad yesxesser anagraw-ik! Ur t-tessbedday ara anagar ma teẓriḍ d acu i txeddmeḍ.
problems.install: Yettwasbedd yakan, ur yezmir ara ad yettwasbedd ugar n yiwet n tikelt.
problems.lowquality: Asnas-a yezmer ad yeddu maca ur yekcim ara akken iwata deg YunoHost. Kra n tmahilin am tuqqna tasuft (SSO) d uḥraz/tuɣalin ɣer deffir zemrent ad ilint ur llint ara, neɣ ur yettqadar ara tisekkirin yelhan.
problems.ram: Asnas-a yeḥwaǧ {required} n tkatut RAM akken ad yettwasbedd/ad yettwaleqqem maca {current} kan i yellan tura. Ɣas yezmer ad yeddu, tarrayt n usebded-is teḥwaǧ aṭas n tkatut RAM, dɣa aqeddac-ik yezmer ad yeḥbes yerna ad yecceḍ mačči d kra.
problems.thirdparty: Asnas-a ur yelli ara deg umuɣ unṣib n YunoHost. Asebded n yisnasen n wis tlata yezmer ad yesxesser talwit d tɣellist n unagraw-ik. Yessefk ur t-tessbeddayeḍ ara anagar ma teẓriḍ d acu i txeddmeḍ.
problems.version: Asnas-a yeḥwaǧ YunoHost >= {required} maca lqem yellan tura ɣur-k d {current}, ssali aswir neɣ mucceḍ YunoHost qbel.
